Q402.rule: output switch hung from the RIGHT side of the fixed inductor's pad 2: rot 90 puts the gate edge (SW pad exit between the gate pins) facing L401.2, so SW2 joins the inductor on F.Cu over ~1 mm; courtyard abuts L401's courtyard; D1 (BAT) column at the bottom, S2 (GND) at the top, cap edge toward the board edge

C438.rule: HF output cap centred on Q402's cap edge (offset courtyard half 1.945 + cap half 0.505), pad 1 (BAT) over D1 (bottom), pad 2 (GND) over S2 (top)

C431.rule: first BAT bulk: vertical 1210 under Q402's D1 side (courtyards abut), BAT pad on top, GND pad at the bottom with vias

C434.rule: second BAT bulk: vertical 1210 under L401's pad 2 (where Q402 was), BAT pad on top, GND at the bottom with vias; a ~1.4 mm channel to C431 takes BAT down to R427

R447.rule: LG2 gate resistor straight above Q402's LG2 pin (top-left), LG2 pad toward the pin

R446.rule: HG2 gate resistor left of Q402's HG2 pin (bottom-left) between L401's courtyard and C434, HG2 pad toward the pin, HIDRV2 pad leaves left
